listing.name: What We Left Behind 4.5.3
listing.summary: The domain's fall echoed into history, an event never forgotten. It is up to us - the explorers, the scholars, the historians - to pick up the pieces, and harness the power we once lost. What we lost, and what we left behind.

description:
_***The domain's fall echoed into history, an event never forgotten. It is up to us - the explorers, the scholars, the historians - to pick up the pieces, and harness the power we once lost. What we lost, and what we left behind.***_

__Can be added to an existing save, but only the exploration content will generate. Run niko_MPC_genSpecialContent if adding to an existing save.__

Adds a variety of planetary conditions to the sector, as well as a smattering of mysteries and awe-inspiring vistas. Has Nexerelin and <#1204273543408521296> integration.

Forum thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=25205.0
Gallery: https://imgur.com/a/bxGugFX

Download: https://github.com/nikothedude/MorePlanetaryConditions/releases
